cohort: 12 infants born to mothers who had undergone uterus transplantation in the Dallas UtErus Transplant Study (DUETS)
finding: Infants born from mothers with uterus transplants had a neonatal course that reflected their gestational age at delivery, with no identified malformations or organ dysfunctions at birth and achievement of appropriate developmental and behavioral milestones by 2 months of age.
mod_finding: All twelve infants were delivered by cesarean section.
